scope: Full technical decode plus bounded sampled-frame review against frozen writer card, actual submitted prompt, original source and take one. No human acceptance or numeric rating.

tool.versionLine: ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

technical.durationMethod: 192 decoded frames at 24 fps, constant 512-tick spacing in timebase 1/12288; header duration 00:00:08.00.

audio.measurementMethod: Final ffmpeg volumedetect block after complete audio decode, excluding initialization zero.
audio.peakQualification: Rounded volumedetect reading; this alone does not establish clipping.

directionFindings.expected: By about 1.5s gaze UP toward VIEWER-LEFT, offscreen above the left edge, and held for rest of shot; actor-right explicitly resolved in the frozen writer card.
directionFindings.observed: At 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0s head and eyes turn toward VIEWER-RIGHT, the opposite screen direction. By 4.0s and later the gaze returns toward source/camera-like orientation rather than holding the teammate target.

directionFindings.expected: Brows draw down/together, jaw set, small chin lift.
directionFindings.observed: Brows tense and jaw sets in 1–2s samples, providing a clearer concerned expression than the static first take.

directionFindings.expected: Small up-left companion-directed excursions, one in 1.5–2.5s and one in 5.0–5.5s; hand open between and after; no more than a hand-width.
directionFindings.observed: Two sampled excursions are apparent around 2.5 and 5.0s, separated by a return. Hand travels toward the center/front of face, enlarges and partly occludes face; this does not establish the specified small up-left target or amplitude.

directionFindings.expected: Source-parted lips close within 0.5s and stay closed; no teeth or speech.
directionFindings.observed: Lips are closed in 1–2s samples but reopen by 4–5s and remain parted at the last frame. Teeth are clearly visible at 5.0s, contrary to the frozen prompt.

directionFindings.expected: Same face/curls, AL, vertical G-A-I-B, segmented neck worms and throat eye-disc, pale blue eyes.
directionFindings.observed: AL, G-A-I-B, neck motifs, throat eye-disc and broad face geometry remain recognizable. Blue irises are clear at start and later frames; they are less visible in the sideways 1–2s look, so their appearance through motion needs review.

directionFindings.expected: Single tube on character-right/viewer-left cheek, source-position hoops and rings; no additions or mirroring.
directionFindings.observed: The tube remains on the same cheek in inspected frames; existing hoops/brow/nostril jewelry are recognizable. No duplicated tube or second connector is evident in samples; hand occlusion and movement limit exhaustive verification.

directionFindings.expected: One right open hand with five fingers, no second hand, no fist/wave/point.
directionFindings.observed: One gloved hand stays present with open-palm gestures. Close motion blur and overlap prevent a definitive five-digit anatomy count; no extra hand is evident.

directionFindings.expected: No step, no body turn; shoulders stable; fixed eye-height framing; unchanged armor/tan hood.
directionFindings.observed: Armor and hood remain recognizable and framing appears fixed in samples. Head/forearm move; no large torso turn is apparent. Feet are outside frame, so no-step cannot be directly verified.

directionFindings.expected: Rig tilts then goes under about fifth second, fire gutters, dust rolls/thins, maw may stay open.
directionFindings.observed: Rig tilts, dust rises and rig disappears by the final frame; some rig structure/fire remains visible at 5.5s. Final maw stays open, now allowed by corrected card. Background timing/geometry differ from take one; exact action/beat coordination needs playback.

directionFindings.expected: No speech, singing, music, narration or sound effects.
directionFindings.observed: AAC stereo audio is substantial: mean −15.6 dBFS, peak approximately 0.0 dBFS. It is not near-silent like take one. Audio content has not been auditioned, so presence of speech/music/specific effects is unclassified.
Eyes are closed in the 2.5s sample. Sparse samples do not establish total blink count or duration.

comparisonToTakeOne.performance: Concern and hand motion added, but opposite eyeline and later mouth reopening conflict with the author direction.
comparisonToTakeOne.audio: Take-one mean/peak −91.0/−78.3 dBFS; take-two −15.6/0.0 dBFS. Same analysis method; no content audition claimed.
comparisonToTakeOne.background: Rig/maw/dust timing and geometry also differ. Same starting source/settings support an artistic performance revision comparison, not strict isolation of every change.

nextOwnerReview: Root normal-speed playback and listening, especially eyeline/hold, hand amplitude/target, mouth/teeth, audio content and beat coordination.
Claude receives the measured mismatches and owns any new storyboard direction or provider prompt.
No automatic retry, replacement, rating or production promotion from this record.
storage: New D: review artifacts and append-only record only. Take-one originals/records, source, actual prompt, frozen writer card, receipts and site/canonical reviews unchanged.
